visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a toddler in a high chair holding a spoon, followed by a cut to him eating heartily from a divided plate. A young man with dark hair feeds him. The scene transitions to a montage of the toddler sleeping in various twisted positions on a white bed with plush toys. (2) The toddler is shown drinking from a baby bottle while sitting on the bed. The father looks frustrated, holding his head. He then displays a stained bedsheet and places it into a silver front-loading washing machine in a well-lit laundry area. (3) A woman with short hair and a green patterned top holds a large blue package of MamyPoko diapers, pointing to the features. The family of three poses together happily with the product in a bright indoor living space. (4) The toddler walks toward the camera carrying the large diaper package. Detailed close-ups follow, showing the father's hand demonstrating the elasticity of the high waistband and the double-layered leg cuffs of a blue-tinted diaper. Pikachu and Charmander plush toys are placed on the bed. (5) A technical demonstration occurs where a diaper is held in a clear acrylic frame. A hand pours several cups of dark blue liquid into the diaper. A counter overlay tracks the count. A dry white tissue is pressed onto the surface to show no residue. (6) A morning scene shows the father opening curtains to reveal a city skyline. The family is seen dining in a brightly lit restaurant and later playing in a green park. The final shot shows the family holding diaper packs with a QR code overlay.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A father in a grey t-shirt and glasses, a mother with short dark hair in various casual shirts, and a young toddler boy.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator begins with a friendly, casual conversational tone. Bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar BGM plays continuously. (2) Narrative shift: The tone becomes slightly exaggerated as the father expresses worry. Short 'pop' SFX accompany text transitions. The sound of a plastic diaper bag rustling is clearly audible. (3) A 'ding' sound effect punctuates the transition as the mother introduces the product. Music maintains a happy, upbeat energy. (4) Technical sequence: Clear splashing and liquid pouring sounds are layered in as blue water is added to the diaper. A rhythmic 'ping' sound follows each increment of the liquid count (+1 to +8). (5) High-energy narrative continues with 'whoosh' sounds for rapid visual cuts. Background ambient birds chirping can be heard faintly during the outdoor park scene. (6) The audio concludes with a definitive brand slogan delivered by the male narrator, supported by a final bright musical chord.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Demonstration -> Benefit -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote MamyPoko night-time diaper pants by showcasing their high absorbency and ability to prevent leaks during long sleep cycles, thereby improving family sleep quality and morning routines.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product packaging, demonstration of product features, verbal and textual brand mentions, and a final call to action with coupons.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy social media editing style with bright colors and rapid cuts to maintain viewer engagement. The combination of relatable parenting struggles (wet bedsheets) with a scientific absorbency test makes the advertisement highly effective.
